en: Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, symmetrical institutional building with a central pedimented section and two long side wings. The foreground features a landscaped garden or park with small trees and paths. The text in red at the top identifies the location as Kamenz in Saxony and names the building as a Barmherzigkeits-Stift (charitable foundation). Additional text is inscribed on the façade above the central entrance.
